items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: He stayed with Lionel Hampton a couple of years.

ctx.x: How long did he keep playing music?

He stayed with Lionel Hampton a couple of years. Then he quit, and started teaching. Got tired of traveling. He said he got to teaching. He got some kind of blood disease, and he died -- in Chicago. Nice cat, too. He was only 16 then, but he had the ideas of a grown man. You've seen guys like that. When he was 16 he acted like a man. He sure could play. When he came in there and took Rouse's place, them guys said, "Man, I know you ain't gonna miss Rouse, is you." I said, "No, I don't think so." See, he was way…
Did Rouse ever catch up to him and pass him up? Because Rouse played so much tenor, you know...
